extraFacts.fact: ISO 8434-1 (the successor to DIN 2353) covers 24° cone compression tube fittings in the light (L) series and the heavy (S) series, sized by tube outside diameter in millimetres.

316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 austenitic stainless steel (carbon 0.03 % maximum), which is why it can be welded without carbide precipitation at the grain boundaries; it contains molybdenum for resistance to chloride pitting.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A240 / A276 chemical composition limits for UNS S31603

faqs.q: What is the Double crimp standpipe used for?
faqs.a: The double crimp standpipe is a 316L stainless-steel straight standpipe with a 24° cone (DIN 2353) and a double-crimp ferrule, for tube sizes from 6 to 42 mm outside diameter in the light and heavy series. It is a rigid stainless tube end that a hose is crimped onto in two places, so a 24° cone nut can connect the hose to a tube fitting or port, or the standpipe can pass through a panel.

faqs.q: Which sizes does the Double crimp standpipe come in?
faqs.a: The double crimp standpipe is listed for tube outside diameters from 6 to 42 mm, in light and heavy series. The listing has no part-number table, so send the tube size, series and hose bore and we confirm the part.

faqs.q: How do I choose the series and tube size for the double crimp standpipe?
faqs.a: Read the tube outside diameter and the series, light or heavy, from the mating fitting: the 24° cone is the same, but the nut thread and pressure rating differ. Then give the hose bore so the crimp is sized correctly, since the standpipe is crimped on both sides.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Double crimp standpipe have?
faqs.a: The listing gives the Double crimp standpipe no pressure figure of its own: the pressure of the finished assembly tracks the hose grade and ferrule when it is crimped to the correct diameter. Pick the hose first, then confirm that the hose rating suits the DIN 2353 24° cone, tube OD 6 to 42 mm port before you order.

faqs.q: What is the Double crimp standpipe made from, and where does stainless suit it?
faqs.a: The Double crimp standpipe is machined from 316L stainless steel, passivated with no plating, so its corrosion resistance comes from the native oxide layer. It suits marine, chemical, food-grade and washdown service where zinc-plated carbon steel corrodes. The listing gives -40°C to +200°C, limited by the hose and any O-ring.

faqs.q: Which standards does the Double crimp standpipe follow?
faqs.a: The Double crimp standpipe is listed to DIN 2353 and ISO 8434-1. ISO 8434-1 is the successor to DIN 2353 and covers 24° cone fittings in the light and heavy series by tube outside diameter, with the 24° cone sealing the joint.

faqs.q: What is special about crimping a double crimp standpipe?
